posts.label: Carousel 1

slides.title: The night I almost sent the resignation email
slides.body: The story no one posts about.

slides.title: It was 11:47 PM on a Tuesday
slides.body: She had the email open. She'd written 'Dear [Name]' and then just left it there, blinking.

slides.title: The cons column was two pages long
slides.body: The pros column said: 'good benefits.' That was it.

slides.title: She didn't send it
slides.body: Not because she talked herself out of it. Because she opened her journal first.

slides.title: She wrote: 'I don't hate the job. I hate feeling invisible in it.'
slides.body: That was the sentence that changed everything.

slides.title: Sometimes the thing you want to quit isn't the job
slides.body: It's the version of yourself you've been trying to maintain in a space that never fit.

slides.title: What's something you've been wanting to quit — and what does staying look like if you're honest?
